description: Ministry of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education -  Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2079/35 of 11.07.2018
reasoning: This gazette contains a legal/regulatory order made under Section 25A of the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It amends Schedule II to a previous order and specifies conditions for recognizing a private institution to offer a degree program. The content focuses on regulatory framework and compliance requirements for higher education institutions, which falls under Legal/Regulatory classification rather than government personnel or structural changes.
